summary: Iteration 2 testing of MEP Quiz follow-up features: Live leaderboard (/admin/live), Set Health check (tab-readiness + GET /api/admin/health-check), and regressions from iteration_1. Added /app/backend/tests/test_health_check.py (7 tests) covering auth, seeded-all-ready shape, deletion flagging + restore-to-ready, duplicate question text flagging, and PUT validation with blank/missing option. Full pytest run: 28/28 passing (21 original + 7 new). Playwright at 1600x900 verified: live-view-btn on dashboard, /admin/live redirects to /admin/login without token AND with invalid/expired token (401), fullscreen-btn + exit-live-btn render, Set health tab renders 20 cards, and auto-refresh worked (Players count went 41 -> 42 within ~5s after a new registration via in-page fetch).

minor.issue: Any set with >20 questions is flagged as CHECK (ready=False) via 'N questions — only the first 20 will be served'. This is technically informational (server only serves first 20), but by mixing it into the same `issues` list it downgrades the set to blocked. Consider splitting into `warnings` vs blocking `issues`, or make >20 a warning that keeps ready=True.

issues: Username/password inputs have no name attribute and Sign in button has no type='submit' — makes automated testing slightly harder; not user-visible.
Players/Avg score cards show em-dash '—' momentarily until stats API resolves; harmless flash but could show 0/loading skeleton for polish.

action_items: Optional: split health-check output into warnings vs blocking issues so a set with >20 questions (bulk import residue) does not appear as CHECK on the readiness screen.
Optional polish: add name/type attributes on AdminLogin form fields and show 0 instead of em-dash while live stats are loading.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_health_check(): the >TOTAL_QUESTIONS branch marks the set as not ready — depending on product intent this is either a feature (over-provisioned sets flagged) or a small bug (extras are ignored at serve time anyway). Consider a separate `warnings` field.

LiveLeaderboard.jsx: polling every 5s via setInterval is fine for a big-screen view but there is no pause when the tab is hidden — could hammer the API for hours during a long event. document.visibilityState check would save some load.
ReadinessPanel.jsx: single load() call on mount + manual Re-check button; consider auto-polling (say every 30s) so admins see live changes as they edit questions.

server.py duplicate detection compares full text case-insensitively but does not normalise punctuation/whitespace beyond .strip().lower() — near-duplicates ('What is 2+2?' vs 'What is 2+2 ?') would not be caught. Low priority.
auth.py + register(): retry/backoff on FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED confirmed working under a 35-request burst (max skew 1). Good.
seed_data_creation: test_health_check.py briefly deletes and re-adds one question in set 10 and adds+removes a duplicate in set 11 (self-cleaning). Playwright registered one TEST_lr_* participant on set 2 to verify auto-refresh. Cumulative regression state after this run: set 20 has ~24 questions (from bulk-import parser test running twice) and contains 2 duplicate texts, so it is legitimately flagged as CHECK in health-check.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests split across two files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (iteration_1) + /app/backend/tests/test_health_check.py (iteration_2). pytest.ini pins -n 2 --dist loadscope; run serial with `-n 0` because several tests use /api/admin/reset-attempts. Set 20 is intentionally 'dirty' after a full run (bulk import + duplicate) — test_shape_and_seeded_all_ready explicitly excludes set 20 from the strict all-ready assertion. Live leaderboard poll interval is 5s. Data-testids used: live-view-btn, tab-readiness, readiness-panel, readiness-refresh, readiness-set-<id>, live-leaderboard, live-total, live-rows, fullscreen-btn, exit-live-btn.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. One product-intent question flagged (see minor list) around treating >20 questions as blocking vs warning.
